ways.label: Tawarau Falls Loop Track from Appletree Road end
evidence: From the Appletree Road end and heading to the Tawarau Falls the track climbs briefly then drops to the Tawarau River.
The track continues on to complete the loop or you can return the way you came.

ways.label: Return to Tawarau Falls the way you came
evidence: Time: 3 hr to complete loop or 2 hr return to Tawarau Falls
The track continues on to complete the loop or you can return the way you came.

ways.label: Double Falls Track from Appletree Road end
evidence: You can reach these beautiful and secluded falls from Appletree Road end, or along the Gorge Track.
From Appletree Road end, a well-formed track takes you through regenerating native forest and then through a pine block on a forestry road for a short section.
The last 20 minutes is a steep descent to the falls.

ways.label: Double Falls from Were Road along the Gorge Track

via.name: swingbridge
via.quote: the Tawarau/Double Falls track branches off the Gorge Track across a swingbridge

evidence: Time: 3 hr 30 min from Were Road or 2 hr from Appletree Road end
From Were Road end, the Tawarau/Double Falls track branches off the Gorge Track across a swingbridge, after approximately 2 hours.

ways.label: Gorge Track from Were Road to Speedies Road

end.name: Speedies Road
end.quote: The main track continues down the river to Speedies Road.

evidence: Access this track from either Were Road or Speedies Road.
This track follows Mangaohae Stream until it flows through a spectacular limestone gorge and enters the Tawarau River.
The main track continues down the river to Speedies Road.

access_points.name: Speedies Road end
access_points.quote: From Speedies Road end, the Tawarau/Double Falls track junction is about 1 hour 30 minutes.

side_trips.name: Tawarau Falls
side_trips.quote: A sign marks the entrance to the falls located 5 minutes off the main track.

doubts: This page describes three separate tracks, so it is recorded as a network. No feature in the packet is at Appletree Road end, so those starts have no ref. The Double Falls ways are given only one-way times ('from Appletree Road end', 'from Were Road') and the text does not say whether you return the same way, so their shape is null. The Gorge Track is described from Were Road down the river to Speedies Road, but the text does not say it is walked one way (no transport mentioned) and its 3 hr 30 min time is not marked one way or return; shape one_way is from the description only. F2 ('where Double Falls Track meets Tawarau Swingbridge') is taken as the swingbridge junction off the Gorge Track. Blackberry Flat campsite, 500 m north of the junction, may or may not be on the Gorge Track, so it is not recorded. Tawarau Falls is both a side trip off the loop and the turning point of the 2 hr return option.
